notes: Smithing and mining relics for the mining town: anvil, pick, ore, a master smithy, an ore cart and a vault of bullion. Core pieces are the working tools; the rares are the Master Smithy (2x4), the ore cart and the precious-metal showpieces.

entries.why: The smith's anvil on its stump
Pick and shovel leaned against the mine wall
Master Smithy, a forge and anvil together, 2x4 centrepiece
Ore cart, the mountain town's emblem (tagged town:minoc)
Bullion vault, stacked ingots of every metal
Stack of valorite ingots, the miner's prize
Miners' Guild sign for the hall or mine door
